description: Sanctions check for a wallet on any chain: OFAC SDN listing from Treasury's official list (entry, programs, list date), plus USDC and USDT freeze status on chain for 0x addresses. A screen of public lists, not legal advice. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: sanctions_check
